_task: ① Two traceability assertions (time_raw copy-paste self-check + time_norm/canonical_id/event_id derivation self-check); ② time normalization switched to dateparser (low confidence -> None); ③ RELATIVE_BASE three-level base (turn>session>chunk) + base_source/base_granularity/time_uncertain; ④ Chinese sample regression; time_precision (day/minute/second, day stops at date) + timezone aware.
_note: Grades A/B/C are no longer hard-coded in code: every schema attribute must explicitly declare fill and on_missing here, with no default (undeclared = schema error, forcing an explicit choice). fill: model = the model produces it / derived = the program produces it; on_missing: fill = the program fills it when missing (must pair with derive) / reject = hard-reject that record and retry / warn = tolerate and strip. Consistency rules (the conflict source is required vs on_missing being two sources of truth): reject ⇒ the field must be required; warn ⇒ must be non-required; fill ⇒ required or not, either is fine. quote.归一化's 'optional' is decided by schema's quote.required (already removed by R11); the code strips a non-required subfield that is empty inside the object, without a separate declaration. _temp_fields are temporary fields (the program pops them after reading, not written to output, not in schema): only fill=model, on_missing=warn allowed; a field with role=fk_hint explicitly names the event that the row belongs to — the field name is 所属事件序号 (integer, 1..n), numbered by the program in ascending 抽取位置 order of cards; the LLM does not write a number in the card. nullable (optional attribute): only allowed with fill=derived + on_missing=fill, and the field must be non-required in schema (nullable ⇒ non-required, the consistency check will block violations); currently only identities.event_id uses it (R12: name mentions are many-to-many, fallback does not fabricate a foreign key).

cards.event_id.note: May be left empty; the program recomputes from 抽取位置.

cards.target.note: R11 downgrade: target dropped required (grade C, missing does not affect scoring).

cards.time_raw.null_note: No time info = null, not reject — 'absent' and 'garbage' are different things; a value must be findable verbatim in the source (pure copy, no normalize rewriting).

cards.time_norm.note: May be left empty; the program normalizes from time_raw + time_ref.
cards.time_norm.null_note: time_norm can only be derived from time_raw by rules; cannot derive = null, never keep the model's self-reported precise value (silent fabrication: last year -> 2022-01-01).

cards.time_precision.note: Source precision day/minute/second: day = date only or a relative day word, time_norm stops at the date and stores no BASE timestamp; no time_raw -> null; time_raw exists but time_norm cannot be resolved => unknown (not day/minute, and not null).

cards.base_source.note: Base field this row's relative time uses (turn_time/session_time/time_ref); if none of the three is available there is no such key (never now()) (nullable: when the base is missing the key is not written; the program does not guess).

cards.base_granularity.note: Base granularity turn/session/chunk (finest of the three levels) (nullable: when the base is missing the key is not written; the program does not guess).

cards.time_uncertain.note: true = time_raw exists but time_norm cannot be derived (including a missing base).

cards.op_type.note: When the model picks other, re-classify via the action-word alias table (extract.py OP_TYPE_ALIAS, Chinese and English in the same table); only words not in the table stay as other.

cards.source_chunk_id.note: Not written by the model; the program fills in the chunk number.

cards.抽取位置.note: Providing a quote that can be matched is enough; the program locates it in the source.

cards.quote.note: Optional; a row with 抽取位置 must carry quote.原文.
